summary: Shows fact-based conditionals: printing ansible_facts to see available facts, running tasks by os_family, and grouping complex conditions with parentheses and or. Notes not all facts exist on all hosts.
questions: How do I run a task only on Debian systems?
How can I see what facts are available for a host?
How do I combine multiple conditions with or in a when clause?
Why is lsb_major_release undefined on some hosts?

answer_card.title: Conditionals based on facts
answer_card.answer_md:
See available facts:

```yaml
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    var: ansible_facts
```

Run by OS family:

```yaml
when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == "Debian"
```

Group with parentheses:

```yaml
when: (ansible_facts['distribution'] == "CentOS" and ansible_facts['distribution_major_version'] == "6") or
      (ansible_facts['distribution'] == "Debian" and ansible_facts['distribution_major_version'] == "7")
```

Not every fact exists everywhere (e.g. `lsb_major_release` needs the `lsb_release` package).
